Name: Winter Mermaid's Pendant
Author: PebbleQuest
Description:
In one of my saves, I [i]finally[/i] managed to get Sam to 10 hearts... Right before winter began. Not having the correct foraging level, I was unable to craft a Rain Totem. What is a farmer in love to do? Wait one month for marriage? Surely not!

This mod allows Pierre to sell the Mermaid's Pendant in winter, so long as the player has met the vanilla preconditions. These include:
[list]
[*]You must have 10 hearts with a bachelor(ette).
[*]You must have upgraded your house at least once.
[/list]Pierre will [i]only[/i] sell Mermaid's Pendant in winter! Otherwise, you need to wait for rain.

At the moment, this only has compatibility for the vanilla bachelor(ette)s. If you're using a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668]Platonic Relationships[/url], you'll still be able to buy the Pendant if you have a bachelor(ette) at 10 hearts, [i]even[/i] if you're not dating them. This is because the mod uses friendship points as a precondition as opposed to dating status. I [i]do[/i] intend to change this, and add compatibility for certain modded NPCs, in future updates.
